versions.content: Storage of Communication Transport Errors Count The RTE shall store number of transport protocol errors counter (errors due to no data is received by COM) if the transportErrorCountEnabled for the port mapped to the signal is set to TRUE. This counter ( TransportErrorCount ) shall be returned as part of optional parameter Rte_ComErrorInfo that can be returned from Rte API Calls.
